The Winners of the 2024 54 Card Game Design Contest!

Main Contest Categories

Best Solo Game
 Harper Has a Day by John Burton
 Astropuzzler by Robert Szalai
 Knick Knacks: Shaker Showdown by Rachel Carpenter

Best Cooperative Game
 Beast Friends For Ever! by Luciano Casamajor
 Wuxia Showdown by Denis L

Best 2 Player Game
 Rainbow Rumble by Arif Nezih Savi
 Starfall Command by Luke Edwards
 Knick Knacks: Shaker Showdown by Rachel Carpenter
tie  Patron of the Arts by Dirk Thesing
tie  Pax Feudalis by Alessio Belli

Best Family Game
 Flapjack Stacks by Jeff & Rylie Wallace
 Banana Boy vs. Uni-Cone by Charles Ward
 Rainbow Rumble by Arif Nezih Savi
 Knick Knacks: Shaker Showdown by Rachel Carpenter
 Nínive by Arturo Vial Arqueros

Best Party Game
 Banana Boy vs. Uni-Cone by Charles Ward
 The Fate Experiment by Daegan Lente
 65 To Juneau by Alexander and Victoria Glaves

Best Artwork
 Flapjack Stacks by Jeff & Rylie Wallace
 The Fate Experiment by Daegan Lente
 Rainbow Rumble by Arif Nezih Savi
 Wuxia Showdown by Denis L
 Pax Feudalis by Alessio Belli

Best New Designer
 Flapjack Stacks by Jeff & Rylie Wallace
 The Fate Experiment by Daegan Lente
 Nínive by Arturo Vial Arqueros
 Starfall Command by Luke Edwards
 65 To Juneau by Alexander and Victoria Glaves

Best Game Using a Standard Playing Card Deck
 Blackjack Lite by Brian K
tie  Fold 'em by Alexei Andreev
tie  Captain Jack by Eric Olson

Best Overall Games

 Flapjack Stacks by Jeff & Rylie Wallace
 The Fate Experiment by Daegan Lente
 Banana Boy vs. Uni-Cone by Charles Ward
 Years Ago by Hep Sosing
 Rainbow Rumble by Arif Nezih Savi
 Astropuzzler by Robert Szalai
 Nínive by Arturo Vial Arqueros
tie  Starfall Command by Luke Edwards
tie  Pax Feudalis by Alessio Belli
tie  Harper Has a Day by John Burton
